name: Kumano
description: Powerful old yamabushi on Kamigawa, once the disowned son of a samurai family.

description_citations.text: "Ryusaki Kumano". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3207 AR a fire kami tells Kumano to flee to Untaidake Peak before the veil is torn; he leaves Reito.
timeline.quote: he was paid a visit by a fire kami . The kami spoke to him, telling him to flee to Untaidake Peak before the veil was torn.

citation.text: "Ryusaki Kumano", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Reito is annihilated the day after Kumano fled; he learns years later.
timeline.quote: It would be years before he learned that Reito had been annihilated the day after he fled.

citation.text: "Ryusaki Kumano", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kumano is visited by kami seeking the reason for O-Kagachi's rage; he fights Kakkazan and resolves to leave and find who lied.
timeline.quote: After the yamabushi's fight with Kakkazan , Great Kami of the Mountain Fire, Kumano decided it was time to leave his plateau
